research.topic: AI 数据中心为什么开始成为盗贼的新目标？
research.editorialNote: 将报道中的两辆拖车和约 130 万美元物资作为已核实案例；把更广泛的行业判断表达为供应链风险，不宣称存在已证实的全国性 AI 盗窃潮。

visual.stylePrompt: VOX-inspired flat 2D editorial paper collage: torn warm-cream newsprint, deep-red arrows and stamps, ink-black headlines, cold-blue infrastructure layers, restrained copper accents, visible halftone and print grain, no photorealism, no 3D, no glossy UI, limited short headline text only.

beats.narration: AI 的下一场争夺，不只在云端，也在一卷铜线里。

shots.scene: 一座尚未完工的数据中心像纸片建筑压在美国地图上，铜色线缆从画面边缘伸入；短标题：AI 的下一场争夺。
shots.prompt: Flat paper-collage wide shot of an unfinished American AI data center placed over a simplified US map, copper cable entering from the edge, torn newsprint, red editorial arrows, short locked headline: AI 的下一场争夺.
shots.motionPrompt: The paper data center pushes forward over the map while a copper cable slides in and a red arrow points toward the construction site.

shots.scene: 铜线线圈、货运标签和红色箭头的平面特写；短标题：不只在云端。
shots.prompt: Flat editorial close-up of a copper wire coil, freight label and red arrow on torn paper, visible halftone and newsprint grain, short locked headline: 不只在云端.
shots.motionPrompt: Layered paper labels shift in parallax, the copper coil catches a restrained highlight, and the red arrow settles on the freight tag.

beats.narration: 报道提到，芝加哥附近追回的两辆拖车，装着约 130 万美元的数据中心物资。

shots.scene: 两辆带编号的拖车剪纸停在芝加哥地图上，报纸数字 1.3M 作为大标题；短标题：$1.3M。
shots.prompt: Flat paper-collage wide shot of two numbered freight trailers parked beside a simplified Chicago map, oversized newspaper figure $1.3M, red recovery stamp, short locked headline: $1.3M.
shots.motionPrompt: The map pans from the city label to the two trailers as the $1.3M newspaper figure unfolds and a recovery stamp lands.

shots.scene: 一卷铜线旁放置 $300K 标记，另一张设备清单标记约 $1M；短标题：铜线 + 设备。
shots.prompt: Flat paper-collage detail of a copper cable coil labeled $300K beside a separate data-center equipment checklist labeled about $1M, torn paper, ink-black type, short locked headline: 铜线 + 设备.
shots.motionPrompt: The red underline draws across $300K, then the equipment checklist slides into focus and the second value is circled.

beats.narration: 数据中心最先需要的，不是模型，而是电力、散热和把它们连起来的基础设施。

shots.scene: 地下电力、冷却管道、服务器机架以分层纸卡拼成基础设施剖面；短标题：先铺地面。
shots.prompt: Flat 2D paper-collage infrastructure cross-section: underground power lines, cooling pipes and server racks stacked as layered cards beneath an AI data center, cold-blue and copper accents, short locked headline: 先铺地面.
shots.motionPrompt: The layered cross-section tilts downward from server racks to cooling pipes and power lines, revealing the physical stack underneath.

shots.scene: 铜线、母排、重型设备被贴上货运标签，红线从工地指向货车；短标题：高价值货物。
shots.prompt: Flat editorial detail of copper cable, busbar and heavy data-center equipment with freight labels, a red route line connecting construction site to truck, short locked headline: 高价值货物.
shots.motionPrompt: A red route line draws from the worksite to the truck while freight labels attach one by one to the copper, busbar and equipment cards.

beats.narration: 所以 AI 的隐形账单，也包括材料、运输和安保。你看到算力，供应链看到的是一条新风险路线。

shots.scene: AI 芯片与服务器在上层，铜线、货运和警示标签在下层，形成上下对照；短标题：算力的隐形账单。
shots.prompt: Flat paper-collage wide comparison: AI chips and servers on an upper paper layer, copper wire, freight labels and security warnings on a lower layer, deep-red divider, short locked headline: 算力的隐形账单.
shots.motionPrompt: The camera pulls out to reveal the upper compute layer and lower supply-chain layer as one connected paper system, with warning labels spreading below.

shots.scene: 纸张地图上的红色货运路线收束到一个问号和警示印章；短标题：谁来守住基础设施？
shots.prompt: Flat newsprint map detail where a red freight route converges on a question mark and warning stamp, torn edges, ink-black type, short locked headline: 谁来守住基础设施？.
shots.motionPrompt: The freight route pulls back into a single red question mark, then a warning stamp presses down and holds on the final frame.

music.intent: rhythmic editorial instrumental with restrained industrial pulse

hook-wide.elementMotion: 数据中心纸片滑入，铜线伸入，红色箭头展开

hook-detail.elementMotion: 标签错层移动，铜线高光扫过，箭头稳定落位

context-wide.elementMotion: 地图横向展开，两辆拖车依次停入，数字纸片翻开

context-detail.elementMotion: 红线先圈出铜线金额，再划向设备清单金额

turn-wide.elementMotion: 剖面从机架向下展开，管道与电力层逐层显现

turn-detail.elementMotion: 货运标签逐个贴合，红色路线从工地滑向货车

payoff-wide.elementMotion: 上下纸层拉开成完整供应链对照，警示标签扩散

payoff-detail.elementMotion: 路线收束成问号，警示印章压下并保持稳定
